title: Lock Desk Rate Sheet Premiums for the Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
Premiums on the Calloway Home Mortgage rate sheet for the Builder Extended Rate Lock are quoted in percentage points of interest rate and vary with the lock term.

| Lock term | Rate premium for the term (percentage points added to the par rate) | Extra rate premium on a jumbo loan (percentage points) | Reduction of the rate premium for fha, va and usda loans (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 0.000 | 0.125 | 0.000 |
| 90-Day Lock | 0.125 | 0.125 | 0.000 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 0.250 | 0.125 | 0.000 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 0.375 | 0.250 | 0.125 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 0.500 | 0.250 | 0.125 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 0.625 | 0.250 | 0.125 |

## Column meanings

- **Rate premium for the term** — the rate premium in percentage points added to the par rate for the lock term.
- **Extra rate premium on a jumbo loan** — the extra rate premium in percentage points for a jumbo loan.
- **Reduction for fha, va and usda** — the reduction in percentage points of the rate premium for fha, va and usda loans.

## Reading the sheet

- The premium rises by 0.125 percentage points with each longer term, from none on the 60-Day Standard Lock to 0.625 on the 360-Day Build Lock.
- The government-program reduction is zero on the three shortest terms and 0.125 on the 180-Day Extended Lock and both Build Locks.
